def collect_feedback_data(
    records: list[OrganizationReviewFeedback],
) -> PriorFeedbackData:
    """Transform prior review feedback records into a ``PriorFeedbackData``.

    Preserves the input order. Defaults ``actor_type``, ``decision`` and
    ``review_context`` to ``"unknown"`` when missing. When a record links to an
    agent review, the agent report summary, overall risk level, violated policy
    sections and per-dimension assessments are extracted from the parsed report.
    Parse errors are handled gracefully — the agent-derived fields fall back to
    ``None``/empty lists.
    """
    entries: list[PriorFeedbackEntry] = []

    for record in records:
        agent_report_summary: str | None = None
        agent_risk_level: str | None = None
        violated_sections: list[str] = []
        dimensions: list[PriorDimensionAssessment] = []

        if record.agent_review_id is not None:
            try:
                parsed = record.agent_review.parsed_report
                report = parsed.report
                agent_report_summary = report.summary
                agent_risk_level = report.overall_risk_level.value
                violated_sections = list(report.violated_sections)
                dimensions = [
                    PriorDimensionAssessment(
                        dimension=d.dimension.value,
                        risk_level=d.risk_level.value,
                        findings=list(d.findings),
                    )
                    for d in report.dimensions
                ]
            except Exception:
                agent_report_summary = None
                violated_sections = []
                dimensions = []

        entries.append(
            PriorFeedbackEntry(
                actor_type=record.actor_type or "unknown",
                decision=record.decision or "unknown",
                review_context=record.review_context or "unknown",
                agent_verdict=record.verdict,
                agent_risk_level=agent_risk_level,
                reason=record.reason,
                agent_report_summary=agent_report_summary,
                violated_sections=violated_sections,
                dimensions=dimensions,
                created_at=record.created_at,
            )
        )

    return PriorFeedbackData(entries=entries)
